## Report — Fix Bundle 9e

**Tests:** before (this suite, baseline session start) 283/283 pass, exit 0. After my fix: `npm test` → 294 tests, **292 pass, 2 fail**, exit 1. The 2 failures are in `test/env-scrub.test.js` (owned by a parallel bundle) — `A1 mutant proof (driver/server)` — confirmed **pre-existing and unrelated**: reproduced identically with my `src/env-scrub.js` change stashed out. Root cause is concurrent in-flight edits from other bundles to `driver/host-free-driver.js`/`src/server-entry.js` (both still dirty in `git status`), not my change. Not touched, per the "Watch out" instruction. `npm run check:ship` → exit 0.

**RED-before-fix (real output, 3 of 4 new tests, quoted):**
```
A2 getCapturedCredential('__proto__') typeof: object | === Object.prototype: true
A3 VALUE PRESERVED? NO -- LOST
B2 getCapturedCredential('toString') typeof: function
B3 VALUE PRESERVED? NO -- LOST
```
Verified by `git stash push -- src/env-scrub.js` + rerun: 3/4 new tests failed against original code; the 4th (rotation pin) correctly stayed green both before and after, since Task 3 is documentation-only.

**Rewritten RESIDUAL 1** (full text in file, key line):
> "...when the captured slot ALREADY holds a real value — the genuine ROTATION case... absorption does NOT happen. The re-scrub deletes the new value from process.env... but the captured snapshot keeps serving the OLD, stale value via getCapturedCredential(), with no error, no exception, no signal that a rotation was ever observed."

**Also found and fixed (root cause, beyond the literal `Object.create(null)` ask):** `process.env[name]` for an unset prototype-shaped name (e.g. `"toString"`) doesn't read as `undefined` — it falls through to the inherited method itself. Added `readOwnEnvValue()` (own-property-gated read) used on both capture paths, so the getter's type-check isn't the only backstop.

**Could not do:** nothing scoped to my brief. Did not commit — brief didn't request it and the worktree has unrelated uncommitted parallel-bundle changes I shouldn't bundle in.
